newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT -Emvasa up to buy long term.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -Emvasa up to buy long term.

text.p: Mexican brokerage Abaco said on Thursday it raised its rating on bottler Embotelladores del Valle de Anahuac (Emvasa) to buy long term from hold.
Analyst Marcela Martinez said sales volume is expected to grow by about seven percent this year, and margins "could reach close to 7.0 percent," compared to last year's 3.8 percent.
"It seems that Emvasa has begin to enjoy the turnaround of past trends thanks to the decision of its administration to capitalize the company and pay down debt," she wrote in a report.

The bottler reported a 0.8 percent growth in net sales during the first quarter and a 1.2 percent increase in sales volume. Net profit for the quarter contracted 11.3 percent compared with the quarter before because of lower financial income, Martinez said.
Emvasa last traded on Wednesday at 5.30 pesos. The Mexican stock market was closed on Thursday because of the May 1 holiday. ((--Timna Tanners, Mexico City newsroom +525
